blocks.text: NBA scores today: Spurs, Lakers, Celtics extend winning streaks HOUSTON— Golden State star Stephen Curry left Wednesday night’s NBA game against Houston in the first quarter with right abdominal soreness and did not return. Curry made a 3-pointer — his only basket of the game — with about 7½ minutes left in the first quarter and put his hand on his right side and winced as he backpedaled after the shot.
